title: Union of titles and authors
statementMd:
Produce one alphabetical list of all book titles and all author names (single column `entry`), without duplicates.

Expected columns: `entry`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title AS entry FROM books UNION SELECT name FROM authors ORDER BY entry;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
